purpose: Identity-safe oral anatomy and facial-expression bridge for MARS_CANONICAL
source_of_truth: MARS_CANONICAL remains the exterior identity mesh. Open anatomy is an inserted/retargeted subsystem, never a replacement head.

facecap.name: three.js FaceCap r184
facecap.role: independent oral/52-target reference; never replaces MARS_CANONICAL

bridge: provision pinned FaceCap and Google GNM assets into worker cache
build oral-only GNM donor from teeth, gums, tongue and mouth_sock groups
derive canonical jaw-open from the released GNM expression decoder with rigid upper/lower dental handling
measure MARS mouth frame and fit the donor to it
use the fitted GNM mouth_sock as the cavity cutter/liner; no primitive sphere/cube/slab
duplicate MARS surface before surgery; preserve canonical source hash and exterior vertices outside the repaired mouth
add one identity-safe MARS jaw-open shell key driven by donor lower-dental travel
drive donor anatomy and shell from one jaw/viseme signal
retarget real Rhubarb phoneme timing through OpenFaceFX/Oculus visemes
validate mouth gap, dental travel, tongue containment, blink closure and source integrity

controls.viseme_EE: lip spread with bounded jaw contribution

hard_gates: MARS_CANONICAL exterior identity source remains immutable
GNM mouth_sock is present and non-empty
jaw_open creates nonzero visible oral gap
upper teeth remain anchored while lower teeth move coherently
tongue remains inside the oral volume at neutral/half/full open
no telemetry/placeholder can satisfy animation gates
